description: Create JVSLogo SVG component with chrome metallic gradient effect and racing stripes. Component accepts size prop (sm=32px, md=48px, lg=64px, xl=96px) and variant prop (icon=JVS letters only, full=icon+AUTOWORKS text+tagline). Icon uses linear gradient from Chrome Silver #C0C0C0 (top) to Steel Gray #989898 (mid) to Gunmetal #585858 (bottom). Full variant adds 'AUTOWORKS' text and 'JVS Bongabon' tagline in steel-gray, plus two racing stripes (Racing Red #950304 and Steel Blue #446A91).
steps: Create directory src/components/brand/ if it doesn't exist

Create src/components/brand/JVSLogo.tsx: Export React component with props {size: 'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl', variant: 'full'|'icon'}. Map sizes to pixels: sm=32, md=48, lg=64, xl=96. Render inline SVG with viewBox proportional to design.

In JVSLogo.tsx, create SVG <linearGradient> with id 'chromeGradient' with stops: 0% #C0C0C0 (Chrome Silver), 50% #989898 (Steel Gray), 100% #585858 (Gunmetal). Apply gradient to 'JVS' text or letter shapes.
For icon variant: render just 'JVS' text/letters with chrome gradient fill, scaled to the size prop

For full variant: render icon on left, 'AUTOWORKS' text to the right in text-gray-700 (steel-gray), 'JVS Bongabon' tagline below in text-sm text-gray-600, two thin horizontal lines (racing stripes) under/near the text: one stroke='#950304' (Racing Red) and one stroke='#446A91' (Steel Blue), each 2px thick
Export JVSLogo as default export from src/components/brand/JVSLogo.tsx
acceptance_criteria: Icon variant shows JVS letters with chrome metallic gradient
Full variant shows icon + AUTOWORKS + tagline + racing stripes
Size prop correctly scales the logo (sm/md/lg/xl)
Component compiles with no TypeScript errors
Logo uses only inline SVG, no external images or files
verification: Run 'npm run build' and confirm no TypeScript errors in src/components/brand/JVSLogo.tsx
Run 'npm run lint' and confirm no errors
Create a test page or add <JVSLogo size='md' variant='full' /> to dashboard temporarily and verify in browser that gradient renders correctly and racing stripes are visible
findings: JVSLogo component created successfully at src/components/brand/JVSLogo.tsx. Component supports two variants: 'icon' (JVS letters only with chrome metallic gradient) and 'full' (icon + AUTOWORKS + JVS Bongabon tagline + racing stripes in Racing Red and Steel Blue). Four size options implemented: sm=32px, md=48px, lg=64px, xl=96px. Chrome gradient uses linear gradient from Chrome Silver #C0C0C0 (0%) to Steel Gray #989898 (50%) to Gunmetal #585858 (100%). Racing stripes use Racing Red #950304 and Steel Blue #446A91. Build and lint passed with no errors. Component uses inline SVG as specified. Visual verification: user should run 'npm run dev' and temporarily import <JVSLogo size='md' variant='full' /> to src/app/page.tsx to confirm gradient renders correctly in browser.
